item.title: AAPS National Biotechnology Conference
item.description: The AAPS National Biotechnology Conference (NBC) uncovers the latest science and trends that impact today’s research and pharmaceutical markets, specifically in the areas of biologics, biotechnology products, and advanced therapies. Join leading pharmaceutical scientists May 11-14, in San Diego, CA, for sessions covering new modalities, technologies, and novel strategies in biotherapeutic development.
